name: bodily
description: Bowel/bladder pressure simulation (1m tick), involuntary release, pee/poop/flush verbs, timed relief routines onto any target (toilet/ground/furniture/lying creature; poop drops legwear + squats 20-40s, pee 10s w/ male-stand/female-sit; farts (pressure-scaled) + plops + surface-varied pee-stream sound cues via bodily.sfx; NPCs yell when peed on and bystanders recoil at public elimination, which also emits bodily.publicRelief → indecent-exposure charge; toilets foul until flushed and hold only TOILET_CAPACITY=5 deposits before OVERFLOWING onto the floor and onto whoever is sitting on them; unflushed state is swept on the `world.dailyMaintenance` event using the same stateless owned-room cadence as zones.stains, and can be SCOOPED OUT by hand — a `take` specializedAction that only fires in a room with a fouled toilet, hands you the ordinary `item_vessel_filth` item, and stains your hands (or your gloves); scooping removes the MASS but not the water, so the bowl still contaminates until flushed, and a poop deposit marks the bowl peed too. Carried filth can be THROWN at a creature via a `throw X at Y` input matcher (`throw` is no longer blanket-aliased to `stow` — it is a builtin that reads its preposition: `in` stows, `at` reaches the matchers) — 25% miss, garment-first staining, and a 1-star `filth_assault` charge over `bodily.filthThrown`), toilet/sink use panels, and a `shower` verb (gated on a shower fixture) that fully cleans you — clothing/skin stains, dried fluid, and blood — leaving a brief cosmetic 'refreshed' badge. Stains + digestion loads stay engine (server/engine/bodily.js substrate).

flush.note: KNOWN GAP: requires a toilet in the zone (object_type='toilet' or flags.toilet); errors otherwise. Surfaced as an action-link inside the 'use toilet' panel, not on examine. (The `use toilet`/`use sink` panels are a tagless specializedAction that examine can't surface either — toilet/sink are not in examine's hardcoded object_type branches — but `use` is not a command so it cannot be logged here. The same is true of the `take` specializedAction that scoops a fouled toilet: it self-gates on a fouled toilet being present, falls through to the inventory builtin everywhere else, and is surfaced as a `take filth` action-link inside the same `use toilet` panel while the bowl is dirty.)

shower.note: Requires a shower in the zone (object_type='shower' / flags.shower / name ~ 'shower'); errors otherwise. Surfaced by the furniture.describe hook on any shower fixture, which offers `shower` and `clean` together (you wash yourself and you wash the room), and as an action-link inside the 'use shower' panel. Strips clothing_contamination + soiled_state + ejaculate_state + covered_in_blood (a superset of MIS `wash`, which leaves the bodily stains) and applies the cosmetic 'refreshed' effect.

soap.note: DELIBERATE GAP: was a declaration-only specializedAction on water_source, but that put a SOAP button on the smartbar beside every sink in the world — too prominent for an incidental verb. Discovered via the soap item's description. Needs running water in the room + a carried item tagged soap; bare `soap` washes yourself, `soap <name>` washes another creature.
